description: This file contains the implementation of the WorkspaceMerger class in Drupal, responsible for merging workspaces, handling revision differences, and tracking entity revisions during workspace merge operations.

classes.name: WorkspaceMerger
classes.description: Implements the logic for merging Drupal workspaces, including conflict checking, revision comparison, and entity tracking during the merge process.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Performs the merging of source workspace revisions into the target workspace, handling transactions, revision tracking, and error logging.

methods.name: getSourceLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the source workspace.

methods.name: getTargetLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the target workspace.

methods.name: checkConflictsOnTarget
methods.description: Checks for conflicts on the target workspace before merging (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: getDifferringRevisionIdsOnTarget
methods.description: Returns revision IDs that differ on the target workspace compared to the source.

methods.name: getDifferringRevisionIdsOnSource
methods.description: Returns revision IDs that differ on the source workspace compared to the target.

methods.name: getNumberOfChangesOnTarget
methods.description: Counts the number of differing revisions on the target workspace.

methods.name: getNumberOfChangesOnSource
methods.description: Counts the number of differing revisions on the source workspace.
